title: Mijozlar bilan ishlash
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz mijozlarni inglizcha kutib olasiz, yordam taklif qilasiz, mahsulot va narxlarni aniq tushuntirasiz, shikoyatlarni L.A.S.T. usulida professional hal qilasiz hamda muloyim refusal va mos alternative taklif qila olasiz.
homework_uz: Uchta mijoz suhbatini rol o‘ynab yozib oling: (1) salomlashish va yordam — mijozni kutib oling; (2) shikoyat — L.A.S.T. bilan hal qiling; (3) rad etish — muloyim refuse qilib, alternative taklif qiling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir dialogda kamida bitta narx/raqam aniq aytilsin, mijozni hurmat bilan muomala qiling, 'I'm afraid…' kabi muloyim refusal ishlatilsin va har dialog uch daqiqadan oshmasin. Yozuvni tinglab, o‘zingizni baholang. Keyingi dars: P1-09 Savdo va muzokara asoslari.

vocab.uz: shunchaki qarab chiqmoq (sotib olishga majbur emas)
muloyim rad etish ochilishi ('I'm afraid we're out of stock')

scenes.title: Mijozlar darsiga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda taqdimot qilishni o‘rgandik — ochilish, signposting, savol-javob. Bugun esa taqdimotingiz bilan eshikka kirib kelgan mijoz bilan ishlash. Mijoz xizmati — bu uch daqiqalik emas, har bir mijoz bilan uch daqiqalik. Salomlashish, narx, shikoyat, rad etish — to‘rt ko‘nikma bugun to‘liq yopiladi.
scenes.say: Welcome! Last lesson was presentations — opening, signposting, Q&A. Today: the customer who walks through the door after your talk. Customer service is a three-minute craft done a hundred times a day. Greeting, prices, complaints, polite refusal — four skills, fully covered.
scenes.say_uz: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda taqdimot o‘rgandik — ochilish, signposting, savol-javob. Bugun esa eshikka kirib kelgan mijoz bilan ishlash. Mijoz xizmati — har mijoz bilan uch daqiqalik san’at. Salomlashish, narx, shikoyat, rad etish — to‘rt ko‘nikma bugun yopiladi.

scenes.title: Mijoz suhbatining 4 bosqichi

examples.t: Greet → understand → solve → close. Always in this order.
examples.uz: Salomlashish → tushunish → hal qilish → yopish. Har doim shu tartibda.

scenes.say_native: Har mijoz suhbati to‘rt bosqichdan iborat. Birinchi: Greet — samimiy kutib olish, ikkinchi: Understand — ochiq savollar bilan ehtiyojni aniqlash, uchinchi: Solve — to‘g‘ri mahsulot yoki yechim, to‘rtinchi: Close — to‘lov yoki yakun va rahmat. Bosqichlarni almashtirmang: narxni Understand'dan oldin aytmang.
scenes.say: Every customer conversation has four stages. One: greet — a warm, genuine welcome. Two: understand — open questions to find the real need. Three: solve — the right product or fix. Four: close — payment or wrap-up, plus thanks. Never skip the order: don't quote a price before you understand the need.
scenes.say_uz: Har suhbat to‘rt bosqich: bir — Greet, samimiy kutib olish; ikki — Understand, ochiq savollardan ehtiyojni aniqlash; uch — Solve, to‘g‘ri mahsulot yoki yechim; to‘rt — Close, to‘lov yoki yakun va rahmat. Tartibni almashtirmang: narxni Understand'dan oldin aytmang.

scenes.title: 1-bosqich: salomlashish va yordam
board: 'Good morning! How can I help you today?'
'Are you looking for anything in particular?'
'Feel free to browse — I'm here if you need me.'

examples.t: Good morning! Are you looking for anything in particular?

scenes.say_native: Salomlashish uch darajalik bo‘lsin — 'Good morning!', 'Hello!', 'Welcome in!'. Keyin ochiq savol: 'How can I help you today?' va 'Are you looking for anything in particular?'. Mijoz 'Just looking' desa — 'Of course, take your time — I'm here if you need me.' deb javob bering. Juda tez 'Can I help you?' — yapon samimiyligi emas, bosim sifatida qabul qilinishi mumkin, shuning uchun tana tili ochiq bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Greet with warmth — 'Good morning!', 'Welcome in!' — then one open question: 'How can I help you today?' or 'Are you looking for anything in particular?' If they say 'Just looking' — 'Of course, take your time — I'm here if you need me.' Ask too fast and it feels like pressure, not service; keep your posture open.
scenes.say_uz: Salomlang — 'Good morning!', 'Welcome in!' — keyin bitta ochiq savol: 'How can I help you today?' yoki 'Are you looking for anything in particular?' 'Just looking' bo‘lsa — 'Of course, take your time — I'm here if you need me.' Juda tez savol bosimdek tuyuladi — holatingiz ochiq bo‘lsin.

scenes.title: Namuna: salomlashish va yordam
scenes.say_native: Namuna suhbatni tinglang: sotuvchi bosimsiz kutib oladi, ochiq savol bilan ehtiyojni aniqlaydi va mijoz 'just looking' desa ham hurmat bilan joyida qoladi. Diqqat qiling: savollar qisqa, ohang samimiy, tana tili yopiq emas.
scenes.say: Vendor: Good afternoon! How can I help you today? Customer: I'm just looking. Vendor: Of course — take your time. We've just got the new autumn collection in. Customer: Oh, nice. Anything on sale? Vendor: Jackets are twenty per cent off this week. Customer: Great, I'll have a look. Vendor: Enjoy — I'm by the till if you need me.
scenes.say_uz: Vendor: Good afternoon! How can I help you today? Customer: I'm just looking. Vendor: Of course — take your time. We've just got the new autumn collection in. Customer: Oh, nice. Anything on sale? Vendor: Jackets are twenty per cent off this week. Customer: Great, I'll have a look. Vendor: Enjoy — I'm by the till if you need me.

scenes.title: Salomlashish mashqi
scenes.say_native: Rol o‘ynang: mijoz do‘koningizga kirib keldi, tunda emas — tushdan keyin. Uni qanday kutib olasiz? Salomlashing, bitta ochiq savol bering va agar 'just looking' desa, nima deysiz? Ovoz chiqarib ayting — o‘n besh soniyada.
scenes.say: Role-play: a customer walks into your shop mid-afternoon. How do you receive them? Greet, ask one open question, and handle a 'just looking' answer gracefully. Out loud — fifteen seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Rol o‘ynang: mijoz do‘koningizga tushdan keyin kirib keldi. Uni qanday kutib olasiz? Salomlashing, bitta ochiq savol bering, 'just looking' javobiga tayyor bo‘ling. Ovoz chiqarib — o‘n besh soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: salomlashish

examples.t: Of course — take your time, I'm here if you need me.
examples.uz: Albatta — vaqtingiz bor, yordam kerak bo‘lsa shu yerdaman.

scenes.say_native: Namuna javob: 'Good afternoon! How can I help you today?' — vaqtga mos salom va bitta ochiq savol. 'Just looking' bo‘lsa: 'Of course, take your time — I'm here if you need me.' Mijozga yordam berishni majbur qilmang; mavjud bo‘ling, lekin kuting. Bu birinchi bosqich — hamma keyingi so‘z shundan boshlanadi.
scenes.say: Model answer: 'Good afternoon! How can I help you today?' — a timed greeting plus one open question. On 'just looking': 'Of course, take your time — I'm here if you need me.' Don't force service; be available and wait. Every later sentence starts from this stage.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna javob: 'Good afternoon! How can I help you today?' — vaqtga mos salom va bitta ochiq savol. 'Just looking' bo‘lsa: 'Of course, take your time — I'm here if you need me.' Yordamni majbur qilmang; mavjud bo‘ling va kuting. Keyingi hamma narsa shu bosqichdan boshlanadi.

scenes.title: 2-bosqich: mahsulot va narxni tushuntirish

examples.t: This one costs five hundred thousand sums.
examples.uz: Mana bu besh yuz ming so‘m turadi.

examples.t: The leather one is pricier, but it lasts longer.
examples.uz: Teri varianti qimmatroq, lekin uzoqroq xizmat qiladi.

scenes.say_native: Mahsulotni uch qatorda tushuntiring: nima, nega va narx. 'This one costs five hundred thousand sums. It comes with a two-year warranty. The leather one is pricier, but it lasts longer.' Narxni har doim aniq raqam va valyuta bilan ayting — 'cheap' yoki 'expensive' demang, mijoz o‘zi baholaydi. Solishtirish uchun 'but' bilan ikki variantning farqini ko‘rsating.
scenes.say: Present a product in three lines: what, why, price. 'This one costs five hundred thousand sums. It comes with a two-year warranty. The leather one is pricier, but it lasts longer.' Always state the price as an exact number and currency — never just 'cheap' or 'expensive'; the customer judges value themselves. Show contrasts with 'but'.
scenes.say_uz: Mahsulotni uch qatorda tushuntiring: nima, nega, narx. 'This one costs five hundred thousand sums. It comes with a two-year warranty. The leather one is pricier, but it lasts longer.' Narxni har doim aniq raqam va valyuta bilan ayting — 'cheap' yoki 'expensive' demang; mijoz o‘zi baholaydi. Farqni 'but' bilan ko‘rsating.

scenes.title: Namuna: narx tushuntirish
scenes.say_native: Namunani tinglang: mijoz ikki xil sumkani solishtirayapti. Sotuvchi narx, kafolat va farqni uch jumlada aytib beradi va tanlovni mijozga qoldiradi — bu professionallik. Hech qachon 'this one is better' deb zo‘rlamang; faktlar bilan solishtiring.
scenes.say: Customer: Which of these two bags is better value? Vendor: The canvas one is three hundred thousand, waterproof, one-year warranty. The leather one is five hundred and fifty thousand — ten years if you care for it, plus a two-year warranty. Customer: Ten years… that's convincing. Vendor: It usually is. Which one suits your style better?
scenes.say_uz: Customer: Which of these two bags is better value? Vendor: The canvas one is three hundred thousand, waterproof, one-year warranty. The leather one is five hundred and fifty thousand — ten years if you care for it, plus a two-year warranty. Customer: Ten years… that's convincing. Vendor: It usually is. Which one suits your style better?

scenes.title: Narx tushuntirish mashqi
scenes.say_native: Xuddi o‘sha vaziyatni bajaring: mijoz ikki sumkani solishtirayapti. Uch qatorda tushuntiring — narx va valyuta, kafolat muddati va asosiy farq. Oxirida tanlovni mijozga qoldiring. Yigirma soniya, ovoz chiqarib.
scenes.say: Do the same scenario: a customer compares two bags. Three lines — price with currency, warranty length, the key difference. Leave the choice to them. Twenty seconds, aloud.
scenes.say_uz: O‘sha vaziyatni takrorlang: mijoz ikki sumkani solishtirayapti. Uch qator — narx va valyuta, kafolat muddati, asosiy farq. Tanlovni mijozga qoldiring. Yigirma soniya, ovoz chiqarib.

scenes.title: Javoblar: narx tushuntirish

examples.t: The canvas is three hundred thousand — one-year warranty. The leather is five-fifty — two years.
examples.uz: Canvas — uch yuz ming, bir yil. Leather — besh yarim yuz ming, ikki yil.

scenes.say_native: Javob namunasi: 'The canvas one is three hundred thousand, waterproof, one-year warranty. The leather one is five hundred and fifty thousand — lasts about ten years, plus a two-year warranty.' Oxirida savol: 'Which one suits you better?' — tanlov mijozda. Asosiy xato: 'The leather is better' deb qarorni tortib olish; fakt bering, qarorni esa ularga bering.
scenes.say: Model answer: 'The canvas one is three hundred thousand, waterproof, one-year warranty. The leather one is five-fifty — about ten years of life, plus two years' warranty. Which one suits you better?' The key mistake: declaring 'the leather is better' — give facts, leave the decision to them.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna: 'The canvas one is three hundred thousand, one-year warranty. The leather one is five-fifty — ten years of life, two years' warranty. Which one suits you better?' Asosiy xato: 'the leather is better' deb qarorni tortib olish — fakt bering, qaror mijozda.

scenes.title: Chegirma va to‘lov usullari
board: 'This week it's twenty per cent off.'

examples.t: This week it's twenty per cent off for card payments.
examples.uz: Shu hafta karta bilan to‘lovga yigirma foiz chegirma.

scenes.say_native: Chegirmani eng oxirgi argument kabi qo‘ymang; uni tabiiy, suhbat o‘rtasida ayting: 'This week it's twenty per cent off.' To‘lov usullarini sanang: 'We accept cash, card and Payme.' Doimiy mijoz kartasi borligini tekshiring: 'Do you have a loyalty card with us?' Chegirma raqam bilan, yopiq savol bilan tugasin.
scenes.say: Never save the discount as a last card — drop it naturally mid-chat: 'This week it's twenty per cent off.' List payment methods: 'We accept cash, card and Payme.' Check loyalty: 'Do you have a loyalty card with us?' A discount is a number, stated plainly — never a mystery.
scenes.say_uz: Chegirmani oxirgi argument kabi ishlatmang — suhbat o‘rtasida tabiiy ayting: 'This week it's twenty per cent off.' To‘lov usullarini sanang: 'We accept cash, card and Payme.' Loyalty card bormi: 'Do you have a loyalty card with us?' Chegirma — aniq raqam, sir emas.

scenes.title: Namuna: to‘liq xarid dialog parchasi
scenes.say_native: Boshidan oxirigacha to‘liq xaridni tinglang: salomlashish, ehtiyoj aniqlash, mahsulot tavsiyasi, narx, chegirma va to‘lov usuli. Diqqat qiling: sotuvchi har bir bosqichni tartib bilan bajaradi va mijoz hech qachon shoshilmaydi.
scenes.say: Vendor: Good morning! How can I help you? Customer: I need a gift for my sister — she likes sportswear. Vendor: This training set is our best seller — four hundred and fifty thousand. It's twenty per cent off this week. Customer: Nice — and can I pay by card? Vendor: Of course — cash, card or Payme. Plus, if your sister has a loyalty card, she gets points on this.
scenes.say_uz: Vendor: Good morning! How can I help you? Customer: I need a gift for my sister — she likes sportswear. Vendor: This training set is our best seller — four hundred and fifty thousand. It's twenty per cent off this week. Customer: Nice — and can I pay by card? Vendor: Of course — cash, card or Payme. Plus, if your sister has a loyalty card, she gets points on this.

scenes.title: Dialog mashqi: sovg‘a tanlash
board: Sotuvchi sifatida: salom → tavsiya → narx → to‘lov
scenes.say_native: Rolni ishga soling: do‘stingiz sport ko‘ylak so‘rayapti. Salomlashing, ochiq savol bilan ehtiyojni aniqlang, mahsulot tavsiya qiling, narx va chegirmani ayting, to‘lov usullarini taklif qiling. Yigirma besh soniya, ovoz chiqarib, butun zanjirni bosib o‘ting.
scenes.say: Role-play: a friend asks for a sports jacket. Greet, find the need with one open question, recommend a product, state price and discount, offer payment methods. Twenty-five seconds, aloud, the full chain.
scenes.say_uz: Rol o‘ynang: do‘stingiz sport ko‘ylak so‘rayapti. Salomlashing, bitta ochiq savol, mahsulot tavsiyasi, narx va chegirma, to‘lov usullari. Yigirma besh soniya, ovoz chiqarib — butun zanjir.

scenes.title: Javoblar: dialog mashqi
scenes.say_native: Javob kaliti: 'Good morning! How can I help you today?' — salom. 'What kind of sports does she play?' — ochiq savol. 'This training set is our best seller — four-fifty, twenty per cent off this week.' — tavsiya, narx, chegirma. 'We accept cash, card and Payme.' — to‘lov. 'Does she have a loyalty card?' — bonus. To‘rt bosqichning barchasi bosildi.
scenes.say: Answer key: 'Good morning! How can I help you today?' — greet. 'What kind of sports does she play?' — open question. 'This training set is our best seller — four-fifty, twenty per cent off this week.' — recommend, price, discount. 'We accept cash, card and Payme.' — payment. 'Does she have a loyalty card?' — bonus. All four stages covered.
scenes.say_uz: Javob kaliti: 'Good morning! How can I help you today?' — salom. 'What kind of sports does she play?' — ochiq savol. 'This training set is our best seller — four-fifty, twenty per cent off.' — tavsiya, narx, chegirma. 'We accept cash, card and Payme.' — to‘lov. 'Does she have a loyalty card?' — bonus. To‘rt bosqich — hammasi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: do‘kondagi xarid
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash — do‘kondagi odatiy xarid: Karim simsiz quloqlik izlayapti, narx va chegirmani aniqlaydi, kafolatni so‘raydi va to‘lov qiladi. Har bir bosqichni quloq bilan ushlang — keyingi sahifada savollar.
scenes.say: Vendor: Afternoon! How can I help? Karim: Afternoon — I'm looking for wireless earphones for the gym. Vendor: These ones have sweat resistance — three hundred and eighty thousand sums. There's twelve per cent off this week. Karim: And the warranty? Vendor: One year, plus exchange within thirty days. Karim: Card? Vendor: Cash, card and Payme — your loyalty card? Karim: Here it is. Vendor: Lovely — enjoy your training!
scenes.say_uz: Vendor: Afternoon! How can I help? Karim: Afternoon — I'm looking for wireless earphones for the gym. Vendor: These ones have sweat resistance — three hundred and eighty thousand sums. There's twelve per cent off this week. Karim: And the warranty? Vendor: One year, plus exchange within thirty days. Karim: Card? Vendor: Cash, card and Payme — your loyalty card? Karim: Here it is. Vendor: Lovely — enjoy your training!

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 1
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: Karim nima izlayapti? Ikki: quloqlikning narxi va chegirma necha foiz? Uch: kafolat qancha va almashtirish sharti qanday? To‘rt: Karim qanday to‘ladi va nima taqdim qildi? Javoblarni ichingizda saqlang.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: what is Karim looking for? Two: the price and the discount? Three: warranty length and exchange terms? Four: how did Karim pay and what did he hand over? Answers in your head.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: Karim nima izlayapti? Ikki: narx va chegirma? Uch: kafolat va almashtirish muddati? To‘rt: Karim qanday to‘ladi va nima topshirdi? Javoblarni ichingizda saqlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 1
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: Karim sport uchun simsiz quloqlik izlayapti. Ikki: narx — uch yuz sakson ming so‘m, o‘n ikki foiz chegirma. Uch: bir yillik kafolat va o‘ttiz kun ichida almashtirish. To‘rt: Karim karta bilan to‘ladi va loyalty kartasini taqdim qildi — chegirma emas, ball to‘pladi.
scenes.say: Answers. One: Karim wants wireless earphones for the gym. Two: three hundred eighty thousand sums, twelve per cent off. Three: one-year warranty, exchange within thirty days. Four: he paid by card and handed over his loyalty card — points earned, not a discount.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: Karim sport uchun simsiz quloqlik izlayapti. Ikki: uch yuz sakson ming, o‘n ikki foiz chegirma. Uch: bir yillik kafolat va o‘ttiz kun ichida almashtirish. To‘rt: karta va loyalty karta — ball to‘pladi.

scenes.title: 3-bosqich: shikoyatlarni boshqarish — L.A.S.T.

examples.t: I'm sorry to hear that — let me look into it right away.

scenes.say_native: Shikoyatda to‘rt qadam — L.A.S.T.: Listen — mijozni oxirigacha tinglang, gapni bo‘lmang; Apologise — 'I'm sorry to hear that' — uzr samimiy bo‘lsin, ayb tan oling; Solve — yechim taklif qiling: almashtirish, refund yoki menejerga ulash; Thank — 'Thank you for telling us' deb yoping. Uzr — aybni tan olish emas, faqat achinishni bildirish.
scenes.say: Complaints run on L-A-S-T. Listen — hear them out fully, never interrupt. Apologise — 'I'm sorry to hear that' — sincere, even if the fault isn't yours. Solve — offer an exchange, a refund, or escalate to a manager. Thank — close with 'Thank you for telling us.' An apology is empathy, not necessarily guilt.
scenes.say_uz: Shikoyat to‘rt qadam — L.A.S.T. Listen — oxirigacha tinglang, bo‘lmang. Apologise — 'I'm sorry to hear that' — samimiy. Solve — almashtirish, refund yoki menejerga ulash. Thank — 'Thank you for telling us.' bilan yoping. Uzr — achinish, ayb emas.

scenes.title: Namuna: shikoyat dialogi
scenes.say_native: Namuna shikoyatni tinglang: mijoz yirtilgan sumka bilan keldi. Sotuvchi L.A.S.T.ni ketma-ket bajaradi — tinglaydi, uzr so‘raydi, almashtirish taklif qiladi va rahmat bilan yopadi. Diqqat qiling: hech qanday himoya, bahona yoki 'siz noto‘g‘ri ishlatdingiz' yo‘q.
scenes.say: Customer: I bought this bag last week and the handle tore on day two. Vendor: I'm really sorry to hear that — let me see it. Yes, that's a manufacturing fault. Would you like an exchange for the same bag, or a different colour? Customer: An exchange, please. Vendor: Of course — same receipt, please. I've swapped it and added a small care card. Thank you for telling us — that helps us fix the supplier issue too.
scenes.say_uz: Customer: I bought this bag last week and the handle tore on day two. Vendor: I'm really sorry to hear that — let me see it. Yes, that's a manufacturing fault. Would you like an exchange for the same bag, or a different colour? Customer: An exchange, please. Vendor: Of course — same receipt, please. I've swapped it and added a small care card. Thank you for telling us — that helps us fix the supplier issue too.

scenes.title: Shikoyat javobi mashqi
scenes.say_native: Rol o‘ynang: mijoz bir hafta oldin olgan kamera ishlamayapti, keldi. L.A.S.T. bilan javob bering — tinglang, uzr so‘rang, yechim taklif qiling (almashtirish yoki refund), rahmat bilan yoping. Yigirma besh soniya, ovoz chiqarib — himoya va bahonasiz.
scenes.say: Role-play: a customer returns a camera bought a week ago — it doesn't work. Reply with L-A-S-T: listen, apologise, offer an exchange or refund, close with thanks. Twenty-five seconds, aloud — no excuses, no defence.
scenes.say_uz: Rol o‘ynang: mijoz bir hafta oldin olgan kamera ishlamayapti, keldi. L.A.S.T. bilan javob bering — tinglang, uzr so‘rang, almashtirish yoki refund taklif qiling, rahmat. Yigirma besh soniya, himoyasiz.

scenes.title: Javoblar: shikoyat mashqi
board: Listen: 'Let me see — tell me what happened'

examples.t: Would you like an exchange, or a refund to the card?

scenes.say_native: Javob namunasi: 'I'm sorry to hear that — let me see the camera.' — tinglash va uzr birga. 'Yes, this is a fault — would you like an exchange, or a refund to the card?' — yechim ikki variant bilan. 'Thank you for telling us — we'll report this batch.' — yopish. Muhim: 'I'm sorry' — achinish, 'but it fell down' kabi bahona — hech qachon.
scenes.say: Model answer: 'I'm sorry to hear that — let me see the camera.' — listen and apologise together. 'This is a fault — would you like an exchange, or a refund to the card?' — two clear options. 'Thank you for telling us — we'll report this batch.' — close. Key: 'I'm sorry' is empathy; a 'but' after it kills the trust.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna javob: 'I'm sorry to hear that — let me see the camera.' — tinglash va uzr. 'This is a fault — would you like an exchange, or a refund to the card?' — ikki variant. 'Thank you for telling us.' — yopish. Muhim: 'but' so‘zi uzrni o‘ldiradi.

scenes.title: 4-bosqich: muloyim refusal va alternative
board: 'We don't do refunds on sale items.'
'The nearest one is on Amir Temur.'
'What I can do is…' — chegarani yumshoq ayting

examples.t: I'm afraid we're out of stock — but the next batch arrives Thursday.
examples.uz: Afsus, omborda yo‘q — lekin keyingi partiya payshanba keladi.

scenes.say_native: Muloyim rad etish formulasi: 'I'm afraid…' + sabab + alternative. 'I'm afraid we're out of stock — the next batch arrives Thursday, or I can reserve it for you.' Sotuvda refund bo‘lmasa — 'We don't do refunds on sale items, but exchange within seven days.' Do‘konga yaqin filial: 'The nearest one is on Amir Temur avenue.' Radni har doim alternative bilan qo‘lga oling.
scenes.say: Polite refusal formula: 'I'm afraid…' plus a reason plus an alternative. 'I'm afraid we're out of stock — the next batch arrives Thursday, or I can reserve it.' No refunds on sale: 'We don't do refunds on sale items, but exchange within seven days.' Another branch: 'The nearest one is on Amir Temur avenue.' Always pair the no with a yes-option.
scenes.say_uz: Muloyim rad formulasi: 'I'm afraid…' + sabab + alternative. 'I'm afraid we're out of stock — the next batch arrives Thursday, or I can reserve it.' Sotuvda refund yo‘q: 'We don't do refunds on sale items, but exchange within seven days.' Boshqa filial: 'The nearest one is on Amir Temur avenue.' Har 'yo‘q' — bitta 'ha' bilan.

scenes.title: Namuna: refusal + alternative
scenes.say_native: Namunani tinglang: mijoz muddati o‘tgan kupon bilan keldi. Sotuvchi radni uzr bilan boshlaydi, sababni tushuntiradi va alternative taklif qiladi — yangi aksiya yoki kichik chegirma. Mijoz ketayotib ham do‘konga yaxshi baho beradi — bu refusalning san’ati.
scenes.say: Customer: Here — my ten per cent coupon. Vendor: I'm so sorry, this coupon expired on Sunday. What I can do: the same offer runs again next week, or I can give you five per cent today as a gesture. Which would you prefer? Customer: Five per cent today, then. Vendor: Lovely — thank you for understanding.
scenes.say_uz: Customer: Here — my ten per cent coupon. Vendor: I'm so sorry, this coupon expired on Sunday. What I can do: the same offer runs again next week, or I can give you five per cent today as a gesture. Which would you prefer? Customer: Five per cent today, then. Vendor: Lovely — thank you for understanding.

scenes.title: Muloyim rad mashqi
scenes.say_native: Rol o‘ynang: mijoz siyosatsiz refund talab qilyapti — mahsulot ochilgan. 'I'm afraid…' bilan boshlang, sababni ayting va alternative taklif qiling: kredit karta'ga store credit, almashtirish yoki menejer bilan maslahatlashish. Yigirma soniya, ohang iliq bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Role-play: a customer demands a refund outside policy — the product was opened. Start with 'I'm afraid…', give the reason, offer an alternative: store credit, an exchange, or a word with the manager. Twenty seconds, warm tone.
scenes.say_uz: Rol o‘ynang: mijoz siyosatsiz refund talab qilyapti — mahsulot ochilgan. 'I'm afraid…', sabab, alternative — store credit, almashtirish yoki menejer. Yigirma soniya, iliq ohang.

scenes.title: Javoblar: refusal mashqi

examples.t: What I can do: store credit, or exchange it for a sealed unit now.
examples.uz: Men qila oladigani: store credit, yoki hozir muhrlangan birlikka almashtirish.

scenes.say_native: Javob namunasi: 'I'm afraid we can't refund opened products — but what I can do is offer store credit, or exchange it for a sealed unit now. If you'd like, the manager can also have a look.' Muhim: 'no' so‘zini yakka ishlatmang; 'I'm afraid' har doim sabab va two-option alternative bilan yopiladi, mijoz o‘zini matn emas, tanlov egasi his qiladi.
scenes.say: Model answer: 'I'm afraid we can't refund opened products — but what I can do is store credit, or an exchange for a sealed unit now. Or the manager can have a look, if you'd like.' Key: never a bare 'no' — 'I'm afraid' plus a reason plus two options, so the customer feels like an owner of a choice, not a blocked request.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna: 'I'm afraid we can't refund opened products — but what I can do is store credit, or an exchange for a sealed unit now. The manager can have a look too.' Yakka 'no' yo‘q — 'I'm afraid' + sabab + ikki variant. Mijoz tanlov egasi bo‘lsin.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: kassada shikoyat
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash — kassada shikoyat: Nigora shikastlangan blender bilan keldi. Sotuvchi L.A.S.T. bilan tinglaydi, uzr so‘raydi, yechim taklif qiladi va mijozni rahmat bilan yopadi. Ko‘rib turibsiz: hech qanday himoya, hech qanday 'lekin' — faqat professional xizmat. Diqqat bilan tinglang.
scenes.say: Nigora: Excuse me — this blender stopped working after two days. Vendor: I'm so sorry — let me see. I see, the blade seized. That's not normal. Would you like an exchange or a refund? Nigora: Refund, please. Vendor: Of course — same receipt? Nigora: Here. Vendor: Refunded to your card — seven hundred and twenty thousand. Thank you for telling us — I'll flag this batch to quality control. Nigora: Thanks for sorting it. Vendor: Any time.
scenes.say_uz: Nigora: Excuse me — this blender stopped working after two days. Vendor: I'm so sorry — let me see. I see, the blade seized. That's not normal. Would you like an exchange or a refund? Nigora: Refund, please. Vendor: Of course — same receipt? Nigora: Here. Vendor: Refunded to your card — seven hundred and twenty thousand. Thank you for telling us — I'll flag this batch to quality control. Nigora: Thanks for sorting it. Vendor: Any time.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 2
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: Nigoraning muammosi nima edi? Ikki: sotuvchi muammoni qanday aniqladi — qanday shikast? Uch: Nigora qaysi yechimni tanladi — exchange yoki refund? To‘rt: qaytarilgan summa qancha edi? Javoblarni ichingizda saqlang.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: what was Nigora's problem? Two: how did the vendor identify the fault? Three: which solution did Nigora choose? Four: what amount was refunded? Answers in your head.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: Nigoraning muammosi nima edi? Ikki: sotuvchi shikastni qanday aniqladi? Uch: Nigora qaysi yechimni tanladi? To‘rt: qaytarilgan summa qancha edi? Javoblarni ichingizda saqlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 2
board: 2. Pichoq tiqilib qolgan — ishlab chiqarish shikasti
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: blender ikki kunda ishdan chiqdi. Ikki: sotuvchi pichoq tiqilib qolganini ko‘rdi — 'That's not normal' deb aytdi, ya’ni ishlab chiqarish shikasti. Uch: Nigora refundni tanladi, karta orqali. To‘rt: yetti yuz yigirma ming so‘m qaytarildi va batch sifat nazoratiga belgilandi.
scenes.say: Answers. One: the blender died after two days. Two: the vendor found a seized blade and said 'That's not normal' — a manufacturing fault. Three: Nigora chose a refund to her card. Four: seven hundred and twenty thousand sums were refunded, and the batch was flagged to quality control.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: blender ikki kunda ishdan chiqdi. Ikki: pichoq tiqildi — 'That's not normal' — ishlab chiqarish shikasti. Uch: Nigora refund tanladi, kartaga. To‘rt: yetti yuz yigirma ming sum qaytarildi, batch sifat nazoratiga belgilandi.

scenes.title: Keng tarqalgan 6 xato
scenes.say_native: Olti xatoni bartaraf eting. Bir: 'It's not our fault' — ayb ni kimdagi ekani muhim emas, avvalo achinish. Ikki: yetkazib beruvchini ayblash — bahona emas, ishonchni o‘ldiradi. Uch: mijoz gapini bo‘lish — shikoyatda sabr. To‘rt: yakka 'no' — har doim alternative bilan. Besh: narxni taxminan aytish — doim aniq raqam. Oltinchi: o‘zingizdan chegirma qo‘shish — vakolatingiz chegarasi.
scenes.say: Fix six mistakes. One: 'It's not our fault' — fault matters later, empathy first. Two: blaming the supplier — excuses kill trust. Three: interrupting a complaint — patience is policy. Four: a bare 'no' — always with an alternative. Five: guessing prices — always exact. Six: inventing discounts beyond your authority — never.
scenes.say_uz: Olti xatoni bartaraf eting. Bir: 'It's not our fault' — avval achinish. Ikki: yetkazib beruvchini ayblash — bahona ishonchni o‘ldiradi. Uch: mijoz gapini bo‘lish. To‘rt: yakka 'no' — alternative bilan. Besh: narxni taxminan aytish — faqat aniq raqam. Oltinchi: o‘zingizdan chegirma qo‘shish — vakolatdan oshish.

scenes.title: Xatolarni tuzating
scenes.say_native: Uch jumlani qayta yozing va ovoz chiqarib ayting. Bir: 'It's not my fault, sir' — qanday deysiz? Ikki: 'The supplier messed up, not us' — qanday almashtirasiz? Uch: 'No, no refunds. Bye!' — to‘liq muloyim variantini ayting. Har birida L.A.S.T. va 'I'm afraid' formulasini eslang. Yigirma besh soniya.
scenes.say: Rewrite three lines aloud. One: 'It's not my fault, sir.' Two: 'The supplier messed up, not us.' Three: 'No, no refunds. Bye!' Each answer should lean on L-A-S-T and the 'I'm afraid…' formula. Twenty-five seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Uch jumlani qayta yozing va ovoz chiqarib ayting. 'It's not my fault, sir.' — qanday? 'The supplier messed up, not us.' — nima bilan almashtirasiz? 'No, no refunds. Bye!' — to‘liq muloyim varianti. L.A.S.T. va 'I'm afraid' formulasidan foydalaning. Yigirma besh soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: xatolarni tuzatish
board: 1. 'I'm sorry — let me look into it'
2. 'This batch has a fault — we're fixing it'
3. 'I'm afraid the policy… but what I can do…'

examples.t: I'm afraid that's the policy — but here's what I can do.
examples.uz: Afsus, siyosat shunday — lekin mana buni qila olaman.

scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: 'I'm sorry to hear that — let me look into it right away.' Ikki: 'This batch slipped through — we've flagged it; here's what I can offer.' Uch: 'I'm afraid refunds aren't possible on sale items — but I can exchange it within seven days, or give you store credit.' Hech biri mijozni yo‘qotmaydi — barchasi ishonch hosil qiladi.
scenes.say: Answers. One: 'I'm sorry to hear that — let me look into it right away.' Two: 'This batch slipped through — we've flagged it; here's what I can offer.' Three: 'I'm afraid refunds aren't possible on sale items — but I can exchange within seven days, or store credit.' None loses the customer — all build trust.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: 'I'm sorry to hear that — let me look into it right away.' Ikki: 'This batch slipped through — we've flagged it.' Uch: 'I'm afraid refunds aren't possible on sale items — but I can exchange within seven days, or store credit.' Hech biri mijozni yo‘qotmaydi.

scenes.title: Tabiiy nutq: savol ohangi va iliqlik
board: 'How can I help you?' — so‘nggi so‘zda ↑

examples.t: How can I help you? ↑ — warm and rising.
examples.uz: How can I help you? ↑ — iliq va ko‘tarilgan ohang.

scenes.say_native: Ohang xizmatning yarmi. Ochiq savollarda ohang oxirgi so‘zda ko‘tariladi — bu qiziqish belgisi, so‘roq emas. Uzr bildirganda esa ohang pastlashadi — 'I'm very sorry.' Sog‘lom iliqlik — tabassum ovozdan eshitiladi; telefonda ham seziladi. 'Sir/Madam' o‘rniga ismingizni so‘rang yoki 'you' deb murojaat qiling — befarqlik tiiyib qoladi.
scenes.say: Tone is half the service. Open questions rise on the last word — curiosity, not interrogation: 'How can I help you?' An apology falls — 'I'm very sorry.' Warmth is heard even over the phone — smile while speaking. Prefer names over 'Sir/Madam' — distance disappears when you use someone's name.
scenes.say_uz: Ohang — xizmatning yarmi. Ochiq savollarda ohang oxirgi so‘zda ko‘tariladi: 'How can I help you?' — qiziqish. Uzrda pastlashadi: 'I'm very sorry.' Iliqlikni telefonda ham eshitish mumkin. 'Sir/Madam' emas — ism ishlating yoki 'you' deb murojaat qiling.

scenes.title: Narxlar va raqamlar mashqi
scenes.say_native: Narxlar inglizcha tez tushib qoladi. Ovoz chiqarib o‘qing: 'four hundred and fifty thousand', 'nine hundred and ninety-five thousand', 'two million two hundred thousand'. Diqqat: Britaniyada 'and' saqlanadi, Amerikada tushib qoladi — ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri. O‘n ifoda — o‘n besh soniya.
scenes.say: Prices slip fast in English. Say them aloud: 'four hundred and fifty thousand', 'nine hundred and ninety-five thousand', 'two million two hundred thousand.' Note: British English keeps the 'and'; American drops it — both are fine. Ten price expressions, fifteen seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Narxlar inglizcha tez tushadi. Ovoz chiqarib o‘qing: 'four hundred and fifty thousand', 'nine hundred and ninety-five thousand', 'two million two hundred thousand.' Britaniyada 'and' qoladi, Amerikada tushib qoladi — ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri. O‘n ifoda, o‘n besh soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: raqamlar

examples.t: Four hundred and fifty thousand sums, please.
examples.uz: To‘rt yuz ellik ming so‘m, iltimos.

scenes.say_native: Kalit iboralar: to‘rt yuz ellik ming — four hundred and fifty thousand; to‘qqiz yuz to‘qson besh ming — nine hundred and ninety-five thousand; ikki million ikki yuz ming — two million two hundred thousand. Mingdan keyin 'and' keltirmang ('two thousand and five hundred' — Britaniyada mumkin, lekin soddaroq: 'two thousand five hundred').
scenes.say: Key phrases: four hundred and fifty thousand; nine hundred and ninety-five thousand; two million two hundred thousand. Avoid adding 'and' after thousand — 'two thousand five hundred' is cleanest for clarity at the till.
scenes.say_uz: Kalit iboralar: four hundred and fifty thousand; nine hundred and ninety-five thousand; two million two hundred thousand. Mingdan keyin 'and' qo‘shmang — 'two thousand five hundred' eng toza.

scenes.title: Yakuniy: 3 suhbat skeleti
scenes.say_native: Uch suhbatni skelet sifatida aytib bering. Bir: mijoz kiradi — salom, ochiq savol, tavsiya va narx. Ikki: mijoz shikoyat qiladi — L.A.S.T. bilan hal qiling. Uch: rad etish — 'I'm afraid…' va alternative. Har biri qirq-besh so‘zdan oshmasin. Qirq soniya, ovoz chiqarib.
scenes.say: Speak three conversation skeletons. One: a customer enters — greet, open question, recommend, price. Two: a complaint — L-A-S-T to resolution. Three: a refusal — 'I'm afraid…' plus an alternative. Each under forty-five words. Forty seconds, aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Uch suhbat skeletini aytib bering. Bir: mijoz kiradi — salom, ochiq savol, tavsiya, narx. Ikki: shikoyat — L.A.S.T. Uch: refusal — 'I'm afraid…' va alternative. Har biri qirq-besh so‘zdan oshmasin. Qirq soniya.

scenes.title: O‘z-o‘zini baholash ro‘yxati
scenes.say_native: O‘zingizni baholang: har suhbatda salom va ochiq savol bormi? Narx aniq raqam va valyuta bilanmi? Shikoyatda L.A.S.T. bajarildimi? Refusal — 'I'm afraid' va kamida bitta alternativemi? Yakun rahmat bilanmi? Besh belgi — uy vazifasi yozuvlarini shu mezon bo‘yicha taxrirlang.
scenes.say: Rate yourself: greet plus open question in every chat? Price as an exact number with currency? L-A-S-T on complaints? Refusal as 'I'm afraid' plus at least one alternative? A close with thanks? Five ticks — edit your homework role-plays against this list.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zingizni baholang: salom + ochiq savol? Narx aniq raqam + valyuta? Shikoyatda L.A.S.T.? Refusal — 'I'm afraid' + alternative? Yopish rahmat bilanmi? Besh belgi — yozuvlaringizni shu bo‘yicha taxrirlang.

scenes.title: Bugungi darsning xulosasi
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Mijoz suhbati to‘rt bosqich — salom, ehtiyojni aniqlash, yechim, yopish. Ochiq savollar mijozni gapirtiradi. Narx har doim aniq raqam va valyuta. Shikoyat — L.A.S.T.: tingla, uzr, yechim, rahmat. Muloyim refusal — 'I'm afraid' + sabab + alternative. Va ohang har doim iliq: telefonda ham ovozdan eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Sum up. Four stages: greet, understand, solve, close. Open questions keep the customer talking. Prices are exact numbers with currency. Complaints — L-A-S-T: listen, apologise, solve, thank. Refusal — 'I'm afraid', a reason, an alternative. And always a warm tone — heard even over the phone.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa. To‘rt bosqich: salom, ehtiyoj, yechim, yopish. Ochiq savollar mijozni gapirtiradi. Narx — aniq raqam + valyuta. Shikoyat — L.A.S.T. Refusal — 'I'm afraid' + sabab + alternative. Va iliq ohang — telefonda ham eshitiladi.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: 3 mijoz suhbatini rol o‘ynab yozib oling
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: uchta mijoz suhbatini rol o‘ynab yozib oling — (1) salomlashish va yordam, (2) shikoyat L.A.S.T. bilan, (3) refusal alternative bilan. Har birida aniq narx, iliq ohang va rahmat bilan yopish bo‘lsin; har dialog uch daqiqadan oshmasin. Keyingi darsda — savdo va muzokara asoslarini o‘rganamiz: needs, offers va counter-offers. Omad tilayman!
scenes.say: Homework: role-play and record three customer conversations — (1) greeting and help, (2) a complaint handled with L-A-S-T, (3) a refusal with an alternative. Each: exact price, warm tone, a close with thanks; each under three minutes. Next lesson: sales and negotiation basics — needs, offers, counter-offers. Good luck!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: uchta mijoz suhbatini rol o‘ynab yozib oling — (1) salomlashish va yordam, (2) shikoyat L.A.S.T. bilan, (3) refusal alternative bilan. Har birida aniq narx, iliq ohang, rahmat bilan yopish; har dialog uch daqiqadan oshmasin. Keyingi darsda — savdo va muzokara asoslari. Omad!

quiz.q: What is the correct order of a customer conversation?
quiz.why_uz: Greet → Understand → Solve → Close: avval ehtiyojni biling, keyin narx va yechim taklif qiling.

options: What are you looking for today?
quiz.why_uz: Ochiq savollar — 'What…', 'How…' — mijozni gapirtiradi; ha/yo‘q savollar suhbatni yopadi.

quiz.q: How should you state a price?
options: An exact number with currency, e.g. 'five hundred thousand sums'
quiz.why_uz: Aniq raqam + valyuta — professionallik; 'cheap' hissiy emas, faqat baholash.

quiz.q: What does L in L.A.S.T. stand for?
quiz.why_uz: Listen — mijozni oxirigacha tinglang, gapni bo‘lmasdan; keyin Apologise, Solve, Thank.

options: I'm sorry to hear that — let me look into it.
quiz.why_uz: Achinish + harakat: 'I'm sorry to hear that' — bahonasiz, aybni tan olish shart emas.

quiz.q: A customer wants a refund outside policy. What do you say?
options: I'm afraid that's not possible — but here's what I can do: store credit or an exchange.
Ask the manager to deal with you.
quiz.why_uz: 'I'm afraid…' + sabab + alternative — radni har doim muqobil taklif bilan yumshating.

quiz.q: What does 'The nearest one is on Amir Temur avenue' give the customer?
quiz.why_uz: Alternative taklif — rad etishni xizmatga aylantiradi; mijoz yechim bilan ketadi.

quiz.q: When a customer says 'Just looking', the best reply is:
options: Of course — take your time, I'm here if you need me.
No you're not, you need help.
Let me show you our best sellers!
quiz.why_uz: Hurmat + mavjudlik: mijozni bosimsiz qoldiring — yordam so‘rasa, shu yerdasiz.

quiz.q: Which is true about giving discounts?
options: Always invent extra discounts to close the sale
Only state discounts within your authority
quiz.why_uz: Chegirmani vakolatingizdan oshirmang — xato narx ishonchni va marjingizni o‘ldiradi.

quiz.q: Why is tone of voice important in customer service?
options: It isn't — words are all that matter
Customers hear warmth even over the phone
It helps you hear the customer better
quiz.why_uz: Iliq ohang — telefonda ham eshitiladi; xizmatning yarmini so‘z emas, ovoz beradi.
